story: On Monday, November 2 at 12:17 PM, the breeze is light and the Florida sun holds steady at 80 degrees over Sumter Oaks. Gary has set out determinedly for Magnolia Loop, where Donna greets Hal cheerfully and points out the three flamingos in front while the rest hide behind the hedge. Hal watches on with his usual caution, double-checking the flamingo count against his list, while Rosa, equally determined, is at home penciling a coffee date with Hal into her schedule.
events: Gary headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).
Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos visible from the street and check the tally against L-02
Rosa (rosa shift schedule): Pick an open morning, write 'Coffee with Hal' in ink, and be done with it

gary.thought_process: Wiring's zip-tied and checked, light strips are mounted, amp tested at low volume. L-01 says exterior cart mods visible from the street need Architectural Review approval, and my light strips on the roof and the speakers definitely count. The parade run-up is real, so I shouldn't get cited over my own cart. L-04 lets me run holiday lights from Thanksgiving on, so the lights themselves are fine soon, but the mod filing needs to happen. Nobody's around to talk to, so the useful thing is to leave the house and get over to Town Hall, which is a good reminder I ought to figure out how to get there from Magnolia Loop. First step is heading out to the loop. I'll also keep the volume low per L-03 when I do the full test later.

parameters.content: Heading out to get the cart mod approval sorted at Town Hall before I go any further with the parade rig.

donna.thought_process: I just arrived on Magnolia Loop and Hal is right here, which is good because I've been hauling flamingos all afternoon and he's counting. My flock is by the street, and L-02 says no more than three ornaments visible from the street. Best to be upfront and friendly with Hal rather than get caught fussing with the flock. Then I can go see Rosa and Gary for that porch coffee. Nothing to repeat from earlier memories, so a cheerful greeting that shows I'm compliant is the way to go.

parameters.content: Afternoon, Hal! Count 'em yourself, exactly three flamingos out front, the rest are tucked behind the hedge. Are you heading over to Rosa's porch for coffee?

hal.thought_process: Donna just walked up while I'm standing at her flock with my notebook. I already have the tally to check against L-02, and I've been burned before by her math, so I'll count the birds myself first. Fair is fair, and I'll go by the count, not by what anyone claims.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos visible from the street and check the tally against L-02

rosa.thought_process: I've looped on the shift schedule for five ticks now, writing and rewriting the same plan. Nobody's here to talk to, and I want Hal's coffee on the calendar for real. Time to actually commit: pick an open morning, write it in ink, and set aside the chair for him. Then I can get on with the rest of my day instead of circling the same note.

parameters.content: Pick an open morning, write 'Coffee with Hal' in ink, and be done with it

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
